description: KULIC Advisory, AICTIONBOT™ Workbench. Opens a new Shared Table: one file for two sides, for example procurement and the requesting department, or buyer and supplier. Six fields: need, scope of work, offers, decision, open points (can be ticked off) and notes. The content is encrypted with a key that only the table link carries (the part after #). Returns that link: whoever has it can read, write and delete the table in the browser (no account) or through this connector. Optionally adds first entries. The table expires 30 days after the last change. Pass only what the user wants to share with the other side. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

author.description: Name shown with the entries. Default: AICTIONBOT™ Connector.

language.description: Language of the answer and of the link (German or English page). Default de.

title.description: Project title, for example: Cleaning services from 2027.
